notes: AWLS-SDST stage 4: improve initial solution construction, likely the largest remaining quality lever.
Current greedy_gt_init chooses by processing-time completion and ignores SDST setup on machine append decisions.
Only awls_sdst_initialization is user-confirmed in this manifest.

slots.title: AWLS-SDST setup-aware greedy initialization
slots.purpose: Build better initial AWLS machine sequences for SDST instances by accounting for setup time when selecting the next job operation and machine.
inputs: index: OperationIndex with instance, candidates, node_to_job/node_to_op, and job_to_nodes
rng: random.Random used for deterministic seeded tie-breaking
random_factor and idle_bonus: existing diversification parameters
OperationIndex implements __getitem__((job_id, op_id)) and can be passed directly as setup_time_between op_index
outputs: sequences: list[list[int]] assigning every operation node exactly once to a machine sequence
on_machine: list[int] mapping every real node to its selected machine
The result must be accepted by AwlsSchedule and validate_standard_schedule after AWLS timing propagation.
invariants: Schedule each operation exactly once and respect job operation order in candidate release.
Keep standard FJSP behavior close to the current greedy initializer when instance.has_sequence_dependent_setup is false.
If the slot calls setup_time_between, import it locally inside the slot; do not assume a module-level import exists.
Never call setup_time_between with current_op=None; first machine operation has zero setup.
setup_time_between expects operation keys like (job_id, op_id), not AWLS node ids. Convert nodes with index.node_to_job[node] and index.node_to_op[node].
Pass index itself as the setup_time_between op_index argument. Do not use index.op_index; OperationIndex has no op_index attribute.
Do not modify random_init, build_initial_schedule, parser, evaluator, solution schema, CLI arguments, or benchmark semantics.
allowed_edits: Only rewrite code between awls_sdst_initialization markers.
May add local helper functions or lambdas inside the slot.
May import setup_time_between locally inside the slot.
May maintain machine_last_node, machine_ready, setup load, projected load, or setup-aware completion scores.
May define a local op_key(node) helper returning (index.node_to_job[node], index.node_to_op[node]).
May use seeded randomized tie-breaking through the provided rng.
forbidden_edits: Do not create helper files for setup parsing or initialization.
Do not change AwlsSchedule.update_time in this stage.
Do not change N7/NK move scoring or zi policy in this stage.
Do not touch harness_agent.standard_fjsp or examples/standard_fjsp_evaluator.py.
